gold_sql: WITH q AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_date >= date_trunc('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '3 months' AND order_date < date_trunc('quarter', CURRENT_DATE)) AS last_q, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_date >= date_trunc('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '6 months' AND order_date < date_trunc('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '3 months') AS prev_q FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, q.prev_q, q.last_q FROM q JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = q.customer_id WHERE q.last_q < q.prev_q
question: Which customers placed fewer orders last quarter than the quarter before?

gold_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_date) AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
question: Show monthly revenue for 2025

gold_sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue FROM employees e JOIN orders o ON o.employee_id = e.employee_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1
question: Which sales employee generated the most revenue in 2025?

gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p WHERE (SELECT AVG(rating) FROM reviews r WHERE r.product_id = p.product_id) < 3 AND (SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.product_id = p.product_id) > 50
question: Which products have an average rating below 3 but were still bought more than 50 times?
